The majority voted in favour of a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org/debate/?id=2008-09-03.20.5) that the bill be read for a second time. The majority voted against a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org/senate/?id=2009-02-04.204.1) that these three bills be read for a third time.
